title: paeonia officinalis var. humilis
intro: Paeonia officinalis var. humilis, commonly known as Dwarf Peony, is a perennial herbaceous plant species belonging to the Paeoniaceae family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate anxiety and depression, and act as a natural pain reliever. The therapeutic actions of Dwarf Peony are attributed to its sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to calm the nervous system, relax muscles, and reduce swelling. The bioactive constituents of Dwarf Peony include glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
